name: Chess Coach
oneLiner: Free, unlimited chess.com game review that finds the habits costing you rating and teaches you out of them with your own games. Open source, no sign-up.

notes.text: **https://chess.topc.social/sitemap.xml and /robots.txt both return 404** (fetched 2026-10-30). The site is one page (`site/index.html`), so add a one-URL `sitemap.xml` and a `robots.txt` that points to it before submitting to Google Search Console.
The page itself has a title ("Chess Coach: why you keep losing on chess.com"), a meta description and og: tags (checked in `site/index.html`).
GitHub repo [kamal0808/chess-coach](https://github.com/kamal0808/chess-coach) has **no topics and no homepage URL** set, and 0 stars. Fix both in week 1.

chess.com's limit, from its own [Premium plans page](https://support.chess.com/en/articles/8562418-what-does-each-level-of-membership-get-me): Basic (free) gets "1 full game review analysis per day"; Platinum gets "UNLIMITED game review and analysis"; Diamond adds coach explanations. A reply by Martin_Stahl in a [2023 forum thread](https://www.chess.com/forum/view/game-analysis/how-many-free-game-reviews-if-no-premium) adds: "You can get more depth 10 reviews with limited move classifications after the first."

**The free-review space is crowded with vendor SEO pages** (Chessigma, Chessiro, Chess It Up, Chessda, chess-lc...), all claiming "unlimited, no daily cap". "Free and unlimited" alone won't stand out. Lead with what they don't do: **one game turned into a lesson, linked to the same mistake in your last 30 games.**

Name clash: [Show HN: ChessCoach](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=28765183) (a neural engine by Chris Butner, 506 points, 89 comments, 2021) uses almost the same name. In titles say **Chess Coach: free game review for chess.com**, never just "ChessCoach".

chess.com's [User Agreement](https://www.chess.com/legal/user-agreement) §4C bans links "in the forums or any public comments that contain any advertisements of any kind" and also "unauthorized third-party software". Its [Fair Play policy](https://www.chess.com/legal/fair-play) bans extensions "that analyze positions during play". The extension only acts after a game ends. Say that plainly in the listing, and expect the risk that chess.com changes its page or blocks the button.

Couldn't open: Lichess blog posts (403 behind Cloudflare, e.g. [leetdev's "I coded chess.com game review and made it free"](https://lichess.org/@/leetdev/blog/i-coded-chesscom-game-review-and-made-it-free/QcaQ5Oda)); chess.stackexchange.com pages (blocked for the fetch tool; question data came from the official Stack Exchange API, and the self-promotion rules from the help page fetched with curl); the Chessr and ChessVanced Web Store listings (loaded empty, maybe removed). The WintrCat YouTube video mentioned in a chess.com thread wasn't found. No user counts are given for those.
The Web Store search results page shows ratings but not user counts. Every user count below comes from the extension's own listing page.

Few real people to pitch: most "best free review tools" articles are written by rival vendors about themselves. The only independent roundup found is one chess.com member blog. Week 3 is small for that reason.

channels.name: Chrome Web Store listing
channels.why: The extension's main channel. Searching "chess.com game review" and "free game review chess" shows 9–10 small rivals, mostly under 1,000 users and with weak ratings. None of them says **habit**: they all sell accuracy and move labels. The biggest (Chess.com Analysis at Lichess, 20,000 users) just opens the game on Lichess.
evidence: "chess.com game review" results: Chess.com Game Reviewer (1.0★), Chess.com Analysis at Lichess (3.8★), Free Chess Analysis (3.7★, Featured), what'sthisposition (5.0★), Free Chess.com Analysis (1.0★), Chess Review (4.8★), Chess.com Analysis Board (1.0★), Chessigma (5.0★), Chess Compass (3.8★, Featured).
"free game review chess" results add SabioChess (5.0★), DiamChess (0.0) and Chess Game Analyzer (0.0).
Chess Compass's first line: "Unlimited free game reviews with Stockfish 19: open any Chess.com or Lichess game in Chess Compass in one click. No sign-up." (3,000 users)

what'sthisposition's first line: "Unlimited free game review for Chess.com: Stockfish 19 analysis, accuracy and every move labelled, Brilliant to Blunder." (53 users, updated 2026-10-23). This is the closest copy of our idea: a card beside the board after the game.
Chess Review: 789 users, 4.8★ from 11, open source, updated 2026-10-29. Free Chess Analyser: 693 users. Chessigma: 213 users. Chess.com Analysis Board: 45 users, 1.0★.

Google's [best listing guide](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/webstore/best-listing): summary is "132 characters or less"; "at least one—and preferably the maximum allowed five—screenshots" at 1280x800 or 640x400; small promo tile 440x280.

[Listing rules](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/webstore/program-policies/listing-requirements): keyword spam includes "Lists of sites/brands/keywords without substantial added value" and "Unnatural repetition of the same keyword more than 5 times"; no "unattributed or anonymous user testimonials".
channels.evidenceWhere: Chrome Web Store search pages and each rival's listing, opened 2026-10-30
steps: Keep the name **Chess Coach: free game review**. "Free game review" is the phrase rivals put in their names.
Paste the summary and description below into the developer dashboard listing.

Make 5 screenshots at 1280x800: (1) the [[Review with Chess Coach · free]] button on a finished chess.com game, (2) worst move with the better move, (3) try-your-own-move board, (4) move list with branches, (5) the "this is a habit" step across the last 30 games.
Make the 440x280 small promo tile: board + "Free game review".

steps.do: Category: pick the closest one the dashboard offers for games/education.
steps.or: If unsure, check which category Chess Compass uses on its listing page.

steps: Link the listing from [the site](https://chess.topc.social/) and the GitHub README once it's live.
channels.rules: No keyword lists, no keyword repeated more than 5 times, no anonymous testimonials. Don't suggest a chess.com link-up (Section 5A of chess.com's agreement bans implying sponsorship). Say "not affiliated with Chess.com" the way Free Chess Analyser does.

fields.label: Summary
fields.value: Free, unlimited game review for chess.com. One click after a game: your worst moves, what was better, and the habits behind them.

fields.label: Description (first lines)
fields.value:
Finished a game on chess.com? Click **Review with Chess Coach · free** and that game opens as a lesson: your worst moves, what was better, and a board to try your own moves.

If the same kind of mistake shows up in your last 30 games, Chess Coach tells you it's a habit, not bad luck.

• Free and unlimited, no sign-up
• Stockfish 19 runs in your browser
• Move list with branches
• Never reads the board while you play: it only appears after a game ends (fair play)
• Open source (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/kamal0808/chess-coach

Not affiliated with Chess.com.

fields.label: Screenshot captions
fields.value:
1. One click after the game
2. Your worst move, and what was better
3. Try your own moves
4. Move list with branches
5. Is it a habit? Checked across your last 30 games

evidence: https://chess.topc.social/sitemap.xml → HTTP 404 (2026-10-30)
https://chess.topc.social/robots.txt → HTTP 404 (2026-10-30)
Netlify publishes the `site/` folder (`netlify.toml`), so files added there go live at the root.
channels.evidenceWhere: Direct fetch of both URLs; repo netlify.toml
steps: Add `site/robots.txt` with `Sitemap: https://chess.topc.social/sitemap.xml`.
Add `site/sitemap.xml` listing `https://chess.topc.social/` (and each SEO page below once it exists).
Open [Search Console](https://search.google.com/search-console), add the domain topc.social (or the URL prefix `https://chess.topc.social/`) and verify.
Submit the sitemap and request indexing of the home page.
channels.doneWhen: Both files return 200 and Search Console shows the sitemap as read.

channels.name: Chess Stack Exchange: answer the free-analysis questions
channels.why: People asked exactly our question, and the threads keep collecting views from search. One answer that discloses affiliation and actually helps (mentioning Lichess and others too) is allowed by the site's rules.
evidence: [Alternatives to the paid analysis on chess.com](https://chess.stackexchange.com/questions/32960/alternatives-to-the-paid-analysis-on-chess-com) (2020-11-17, 4,653 views, 1 answer): "On chess.com we get only one full depth analysis in a day, which is very little. Is there a way to analyze more chess games and get all the accuracy metrics as well?"

[Free online analysis engine?](https://chess.stackexchange.com/questions/4385/free-online-analysis-engine) (2013-12-29, 65,175 views, 7 answers): "Is there an online analysis engine that allows you to enter a PGN and get a game analysis, showing where suboptimal moves were made?"

[What are some free chess software for showing the best moves in the final output analysis?](https://chess.stackexchange.com/questions/33325/what-are-some-free-chess-software-for-showing-the-best-moves-in-the-final-output) (2020-12-13, 1,441 views, 1 answer).
[Game Analysis Software](https://chess.stackexchange.com/questions/18262/game-analysis-software) (2017-08-09, 1,066 views, 4 answers).
Help center: "if you mention your product, website, etc. in your question or answer... you must disclose your affiliation in your post."
channels.evidenceWhere: Stack Exchange API (question data) and chess.stackexchange.com/help/promotion
steps: Read the existing answers on each question first. Only answer where you add something new: the habit view across many games, or the after-game button.
Write the answer yourself, in your own words. Start with how to get unlimited free analysis in general (Lichess analysis board, chess.com's own Analysis board), then Chess Coach, with the disclosure.
One answer per question. Don't post the same text twice.
channels.rules: Disclose affiliation ("I built this"). "Don't include links except to support what you've written." Don't answer only questions where your product is the answer. Treat as **no AI-written text**: write it yourself.

[Game Reviews !](https://www.chess.com/forum/view/game-analysis/game-reviews-5) (Jun 30, 2025, 11 replies). Reply, Jul 5, 2025: "im never paying for chess.com again and im going to lichess."
[How do I get more than 1 game review?](https://www.chess.com/forum/view/help-support/how-do-i-get-more-than-1-game-review) (Feb 21, 2023): "this site only allows me ONE review per day."
[Game Review Alternatives](https://www.chess.com/forum/view/for-beginners/game-review-alternatives) (Oct 1, 2023). Reply, May 11, 2025: "Try chessdream".

channels.doneWhen: Launched, with comments answered on the day.

skip: Reddit
Account banned; no posting at all. Reading threads as evidence is fine, but none were opened for this plan.
chess.com forums and comments

User Agreement §4C bans "links in the forums or any public comments that contain any advertisements of any kind" and "unsolicited or unauthorized advertising... except in those areas that are designated for such purpose". Its spam help page adds: "posting a large number of forum messages or comments in a short time can be flagged as spam." Some clubs may have ad forums; not checked.
chess.com member blog post
Same §4C risk for a post that mainly promotes our tool, and a ban would cost the chess.com account the product depends on.
Lichess forum

[Forum etiquette](https://lichess.org/page/forum-etiquette): "Posts that are purely promotional are not welcome in the forum" and "We ask that you keep all advertisements outside of Lichess." Also, the product reads chess.com games only.
Lichess blog

[Blog etiquette](https://lichess.org/page/blog-etiquette): content "mostly or fully produced by AI tools is not allowed", and Lichess may "restrict the visibility and 'reach' of posts that appear to mainly focus on promotion." Revisit only if Lichess support is added and Kamal writes it himself.
hkirat/awesome-chess
545★ but no analysis or game-review section (Books, FEN Parsers, Move Validators, Bots, Websites...). Read its CONTRIBUTING.md first if you try the Websites section; it looked stale.
Firefox Add-ons
Free Chess Analyser showed up there in search results (listing not opened), but the extension is Chrome-only for now. Revisit after a Firefox build.
Rival vendor roundups (Chessify, Chess It Up, Chessiro, Chessigma blogs)
Each is a competitor writing about itself (e.g. Chessify's "best websites" post lists Chessify; Chess It Up's guide promotes its own analyzer). They won't list us.
Aimchess comparisons
Aimchess is the closest "habits" rival but paid ($7.99/month Premium; free tier: one 40-game report a month). Fine to mention in our own copy as a comparison; no channel to pitch.
dev.to post
A rival's "Free chess analysis with Stockfish 17 in your browser" post there got 0 comments. Low reach for chess players.
